entries.snippet: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient from hospital roughly two weeks ago.

entries.title: How these slum dwellers went from one-room shacks to beautiful new apartments

entries.title: FDA weighs a new kind of flu shot based on technology RFK Jr. has questioned

entries.title: Lebanese who fled the Israeli invasion visit to see what's left

entries.title: Darline Graham promotes Trump's agenda in her political debut ahead of special Senate primary
entries.snippet: As one of nine Republicans seeking to replace him more permanently in a special primary election set for Aug. 11, Graham is a relative political unknown facing off against some of the state's best-known GOP names.

entries.title: Democrats see a chance to flip a seat as focus on abuse claims mounts against Ohio Rep. Max Miller
entries.snippet: Allegations against Rep. Max Miller have been public for years but have recently drawn increased media scrutiny amid an escalating legal back-and-forth with his former spouse, who is the daughter of Sen. Bernie Moreno.

entries.title: 13 dead after small tourist plane crashes in Peru
entries.snippet: The plane was taking tourists to see the Nazca Lines, a group of geoglyphs etched into the deserts of southern Peru.

entries.title: How does eastern Europe commemorate the Roma Holocaust?
entries.snippet: In 2015, the EU designated August 2 as the European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day. In Germany, the day is marked with memorial services, educational activites and public addresses. And in eastern Europe?

entries.title: Germany news: Big turnout for Pride after Berlin attack
entries.snippet: Several German cities are holding Pride events a week after a deadly attack on a march in Berlin. A forest fire is burning out of control in Bavaria. DW has more.

entries.title: Germany's long road to equality for same-sex couples
entries.snippet: In 2001, same-sex couples in Germany were able to register a civil partnership for the first time. The Civil Partnership Act was a crucial step toward "marriage for all," which was introduced in 2017.

entries.title: Germany widens deportations to Afghanistan
entries.snippet: Earlier this week, Germany for the first time deported a man with no criminal record to Kabul. Faridoon Tofan, who is currently in deportation detention, fears the same fate.

entries.title: Famed climber Nirmal Purja among 10 killed in avalanche
entries.snippet: A major search was launched after an avalanche struck the expedition high on Pakistan's Broad Peak. The confirmation ended hopes of a rescue and marked the loss of one of the world's best-known high-altitude climbers.

entries.title: More women die in heatwaves, but biology 'isn't main cause'
entries.snippet: In country after country, more women are dying from the heat than men. But researchers say biology isn't the main reason. Age, working conditions, and unequal access to rest may drive the gap.

entries.title: Iran warns neighbors against being US 'defensive shield'
entries.snippet: Iran has warned regional states against helping the US as Washington weighs possible "very hard" new strikes. Meanwhile, the Tehran-backed Houthis claim to have diverted eight Saudi tankers from the Red Sea. DW has more.

entries.title: War in Ukraine: Why Crimea has become a strategic target

entries.title: How crypto miners are stealing power in Southeast Asia

entries.title: Ceuta: Spain demands EU meeting, blasts 'selfish' response

entries.title: Germany weighs the future of minijobs
entries.snippet: Germany's popular minijob system allows millions of workers, including students, to avoid paying income tax or social security contributions. But a reform is on the cards that may soon end this advantage.

entries.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says Patriot missile shortage costs lives

entries.title: India: Modi says he forgives 'children' who abused him

entries.title: UEFA 'rebuilding trust' after FIFA scraps World Cup sell-out plans
entries.snippet: Europe's governing body, UEFA has called Gianni Infantino's decision to abandon his plans to sell stakes in FIFA competitions to private equity investors a "victory for the whole game."

entries.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak becomes world's second-largest ever
entries.snippet: DR Congo’s fast-spreading Ebola outbreak has exceeded 3,500 cases, overtaking the country’s deadliest epidemic and becoming the world’s second-largest ever. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment.

entries.title: UK court allows plans for Chinese 'super' embassy to advance
entries.snippet: A court dismissed a legal challenge against Beijing's new embassy in London, which could become the largest in the UK. The case, brought by a neighborhood association, argued the embassy poses a security threat.

entries.title: Why Europe's wildfires are getting harder to stop
entries.snippet: Wildfires may start with a single spark, but experts say climate change, drought and decades of forest management decisions have created the conditions for Europe's biggest blazes.
